simple.meaning: properly, salted (i.e. land), i.e. a desert
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מְלֵחָה (H4420) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: מְלֵחָה (mᵉlêchâh) means properly, salted (i.e. land), i.e. a desert First listed occurrence: Jer 17 6.

definitions.short: properly, salted (i.e. land), i.e. a desert
definitions.full: H4420. melechah מְלֵחָה noun feminine saltness, barrenness ; — Job 39:6 (|| עֲרָבָה ) as dwelling-place of wild ass, salt-plain ; מְלֵחָה אֶרֶץ Jer 17:6 (|| תֵשֵׁב לֹא ); Psa 107:34 (opposed to מְּרִי אֶרֶץ ).
definitions.rootNote: from 4414 (in its denominative sense); understood as land ( 776 )
